assertions.requirement: Task and workflow cases compile and execute through identical v2 plan/evidence contracts.
Tracked Workflow Runner YAML, including ordinary fields and commands, passes through without parsing or rewriting.
The complete workflow cwd is its dedicated workspace and sibling outputs are not exposed.
Controlled model matrices preserve non-model identity and uncontrolled workflows are agent-system comparisons.
Recovery reuses known terminals and delegates only policy-supported resume while ambiguous effects remain manual.
